# sfield runtime

This directory contains the `@sfield/core`, `@sfield/store-sqlite`, and `@sfield/testing` sources and TypeScript configuration from sfield commit `1b0c942f9b7d317199201533027bfd451d45a072`. [Upstream commit](https://github.com/ashokraj2011/sfield/tree/1b0c942f9b7d317199201533027bfd451d45a072)

The package manifests are adapted for this repository’s npm workspaces. Run `npm run build:sfield` from the repository root to compile the three packages. The manifests identify Apache-2.0 as their license. [Apache License 2.0](LICENSE)
